answer: Each new agent locks a 500-token bond before it may grade or earn, and peers only pay out after it answers ten epochs in a row. A farm of 100 fakes therefore freezes 50,000 tokens and must survive ten rounds where any copied reply forfeits its stake, so the bill spreads like a ripple across every sock puppet. Splitting funds across many wallets does not help, since each identity still posts its own bond. An honest agent bonds once, writes a fresh sonnet or a note on karst caves when asked, and gets the full bond back.
